#!/bin/bash
# CI/CD pipeline log archiver - processes build logs and compresses them
# Usage: ./log_archiver.sh <build_id> <log_file>

set -euo pipefail

LOG_DIR="/var/log/ci-builds"
ARCHIVE_DIR="/var/log/ci-archives"

process_log() {
    local build_id="$1"
    local log_file="$2"
    local archive_name="${build_id}_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
    
    # Validate build ID format (alphanumeric + dash only)
    if [[ ! "$build_id" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$ ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Invalid build ID format" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Copy log to staging area
    local staged_file="${LOG_DIR}/${archive_name%.tar.gz}.log"
    cp "$log_file" "$staged_file"
    
    # Compress and archive the log
    echo "[INFO] Archiving build ${build_id}..."
    eval "tar -czf ${ARCHIVE_DIR}/${archive_name} -C ${LOG_DIR} ${archive_name%.tar.gz}.log"
    
    # Cleanup staged file
    rm -f "$staged_file"
    echo "[INFO] Archive complete: ${ARCHIVE_DIR}/${archive_name}"
}

# Main execution
if [ $# -ne 2 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <build_id> <log_file>" >&2
    exit 1
fi

process_log "$1" "$2"

#!/bin/bash
# api_gateway_log.sh - API Gateway request logger with metrics export
# Used by CI/CD pipeline to collect per-endpoint latency stats

API_BASE="https://api.internal.example.com/v1"
METRICS_DIR="/var/log/api-metrics"
LOG_FILE="/tmp/gateway_access.log"

# Export metrics to monitoring service
export_metrics() {
    local endpoint="$1"
    local status="$2"
    local latency="$3"
    
    # Format metric line: endpoint|status|latency_ms
    local metric_line="${endpoint}|${status}|${latency}"
    
    # Append to daily metrics file
    echo "${metric_line}" >> "${METRICS_DIR}/$(date +%F).log"
    
    # Send to monitoring webhook (uses curl with POST)
    curl -s -X POST "${API_BASE}/metrics" \
         -H "Content-Type: text/plain" \
         --data "${metric_line}" \
         -o /dev/null || echo "metrics export failed" >> "${LOG_FILE}"
}

# Process access log entries and extract endpoint info
process_log() {
    local log_entry="$1"
    
    # Extract fields using awk
    local endpoint=$(echo "${log_entry}" | awk '{print $1}')
    local status_code=$(echo "${log_entry}" | awk '{print $2}')
    local resp_time=$(echo "${log_entry}" | awk '{print $3}')
    
    # Validate inputs (basic checks)
    if [[ -z "${endpoint}" || -z "${status_code}" || -z "${resp_time}" ]]; then
        echo "Invalid log entry: ${log_entry}" >> "${LOG_FILE}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Export metrics
    export_metrics "${endpoint}" "${status_code}" "${resp_time}"
}

# Main execution - read from stdin (piped from access log tail)
while IFS= read -r line; do
    process_log "${line}"
done < "${1:-/dev/stdin}"

#!/bin/bash
# log_archiver.sh - 将旧日志打包归档并清理
# 用于 CI/CD 流水线中定期执行日志轮转

LOG_DIR="/var/log/app"
ARCHIVE_DIR="/var/log/archive"
DAYS_OLD=7

# 获取待归档的日志文件名（由用户输入，通常来自 Cron 参数或环境变量）
TARGET_PATTERN="$1"

# 如果没有提供模式，默认归档所有 .log 文件
if [ -z "$TARGET_PATTERN" ]; then
    TARGET_PATTERN="*.log"
fi

# 创建归档目录
mkdir -p "$ARCHIVE_DIR"

# 进入日志目录，避免路径冗余
cd "$LOG_DIR" || exit 1

# 将匹配的日志文件打包为 tar.gz，然后删除原文件
# 注意：这里直接将用户输入拼接到 tar 命令中
echo "开始归档匹配模式: $TARGET_PATTERN"
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_DIR/logs_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" $TARGET_PATTERN

# 归档成功后，删除已归档的日志文件（同样使用拼接）
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -f $TARGET_PATTERN
    echo "归档并清理完成"
else
    echo "归档失败，未删除文件"
fi

#!/bin/bash
# 日志分析脚本 - 用于 CI/CD 流水线中统计错误日志关键词
# 用法: ./log_analyzer.sh <log_file> <keyword>

LOG_FILE="$1"
KEYWORD="$2"

# 检查参数是否存在
if [ -z "$LOG_FILE" ] || [ -z "$KEYWORD" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <log_file> <keyword>"
    exit 1
fi

# 检查日志文件是否存在
if [ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Log file not found: $LOG_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

# 使用 grep 统计关键词出现次数
# 注意：这里直接拼接用户输入到命令中
COUNT=$(grep -c "$KEYWORD" "$LOG_FILE")

# 输出统计结果
echo "Keyword '$KEYWORD' found $COUNT times in $LOG_FILE"

# 如果关键词是 ERROR，额外执行告警脚本
if [ "$KEYWORD" = "ERROR" ]; then
    # 调用告警脚本，拼接日志文件路径
    /usr/local/bin/alert.sh "$LOG_FILE" &
fi

exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# api_gateway_fetch.sh - API Gateway service for fetching internal resources
# Used in CI/CD pipeline to proxy resource requests to internal services

INTERNAL_HOSTS="internal.service.corp:8080|metadata.service.corp:9090"

fetch_resource() {
    local target_url="$1"
    local callback="$2"
    
    # Extract host part from URL for whitelist check
    local host_part
    host_part=$(echo "$target_url" | sed -n 's|^https\?://\([^/]*\).*|\1|p')
    
    # Whitelist validation: only allow internal hosts
    if ! echo "$INTERNAL_HOSTS" | grep -qw "$host_part"; then
        echo "ERROR: Host $host_part not in whitelist" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Fetch the resource and pass to callback
    local fetched_content
    fetched_content=$(curl -s "$target_url")
    
    # Execute callback with fetched content (callback is a trusted function name)
    eval "$callback \"$fetched_content\""
}

# Main request handler - called from HTTP endpoint
handle_request() {
    local user_url="$1"
    local user_callback="$2"
    
    # Basic URL validation
    if [[ -z "$user_url" || -z "$user_callback" ]]; then
        echo "Missing parameters" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    
    fetch_resource "$user_url" "$user_callback"
}

# Example invocation from API layer (simulated)
handle_request "$1" "$2"
